rules: id は一度付けたら変えない・再利用しない。削除はせず status を deprecated にする(学習データ・ログが id を参照するため)。
question は物体名を {a} {b} で埋めて、Yes/No で答えられる自然文にする。画像だけで判断できることを聞く。
layer: state=1枚のフレームで決まる / event=複数フレームの時間変化で決まる / self=センサー値で決まる(モデルには聞かず、照合に使う)。
status: proposed(案。まだ学習に使わない) / active(使用中) / deprecated(使わない。理由を note に書く)。
sim は、シミュレーションの状態から計算できるか(auto)、人の判断が要るか(human)、不可か(none)。params のしきい値は表の値をそのまま使うので、変えたら version を上げる。

predicates.question: Is the {a} held in the gripper?
predicates.definition: grippers closed on the object: gripper-to-object distance < d_hold and the object moves with the gripper (or lifts together with it)

predicates.question: Is the {a} touching the {b}?
predicates.definition: distance between the surfaces (approximated by the poses and sizes) < d_touch
predicates.note: ground truth from contact forces is better if the simulator exposes them

predicates.question: Is the {a} resting on top of the {b}?
predicates.definition: a is above b (z difference ≈ half sizes), horizontal offset < half the size of b

predicates.question: Is the {a} inside the {b}?
predicates.definition: a's center is within b's bounding box

predicates.question: Is the {a} at its goal position?
predicates.definition: distance between a and the goal position < d_goal
predicates.note: the goal comes from the task; for images the viewer needs a visible target

predicates.question: Is the {a} close to, but not at, its goal position?
Is the {a} off the table?
predicates.definition: height of a above its rest height > h_lift

predicates.question: Is the {a} standing upright?
predicates.definition: angle between a's long axis and vertical < a_up

predicates.question: Is the {a} tilted or rotated from its goal orientation?
predicates.definition: angle between a's orientation and the goal orientation > a_tilt

predicates.question: Did the gripper reach the {a} at some point?
predicates.definition: min over time of gripper-to-object distance < d_reach

predicates.question: Did the gripper close on the {a} and pick it up?
predicates.definition: holding became true and a was lifted at some point

predicates.question: Did the {a} move during the video?
predicates.definition: displacement between first and last frame > d_move

predicates.question: Did the {a} fall out of the gripper?
predicates.definition: holding was true, then false while a was above the table and moving down

predicates.question: Did the {a} end up past the goal?
predicates.definition: signed distance along the intended motion direction exceeds the goal by > d_over
predicates.note: the intended direction comes from start→goal

predicates.question: Did the {a} stop before reaching the goal?
predicates.definition: mirror of overshot: ends short of the goal along the intended direction

predicates.question: Did the robot hit or push something other than the target?
predicates.definition: any non-target object moves > d_move while the gripper is within d_touch of it
gripper opening < w_closed (from the joint state)
predicates.note: asked of the sensors, not of the model; cross-checks the model's holding/grasped answers

predicates.definition: gripper closed to the full range (nothing between the fingers)
predicates.note: closed-on-nothing is the clearest sensor sign of a missed grasp
